Alistar.combo: When Alistar W Headbutt is down and a target your allies can attack is in range, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and root them. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak, stun them with a basic attack, then use Leona W Eclipse. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over a target already caught to aim for a stun at the center.
Alistar.laning: Look for the moment the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit, but first check your allied marksman's position and which abilities they have available to attack. Near a turret, don't give Alistar room to circle behind you and set up Alistar Q Pulverize and W Headbutt to knock you in. If an engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Alistar.fight: As soon as Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down, close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade. Engage when your allied marksman can follow up and attack. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't focus him; back off and wait out its duration.
Alistar.teamfight: Catch a damage dealer your allies can follow up on and keep them in range for your allies to trigger Leona P Sunlight. If your team is behind in damage, instead of engaging first, interrupt Alistar as he goes onto your allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak or E Zenith Blade. Crowd control applied after Alistar R Unbreakable Will is activated still works, so if you can't back off, stop his engage with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak, E Zenith Blade, and R Solar Flare.
Alistar.build: Alistar Q Pulverize, W Headbutt, and E Trample all deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If Alistar's engage can lock down and pick off your allied carry, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is his only mobility tool, so its use creates a window to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, trade back or reposition. When you engage, lock down the target with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and R Solar Flare.
Alistar.phase: After that, Leona's damage won't keep up, so focus on engaging and crowd control in the mid and late game. The available information isn't enough to determine which side is stronger in the mid and late game.
Alistar.watch: Being knocked back by Alistar W Headbutt and then lifted by Alistar Q Pulverize leaves you vulnerable to the follow-up crowd control. Especially near a turret, don't give Alistar room to circle behind you, and don't overcommit while Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are available.

Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding only catches the first target it hits, so dodge it by keeping minions between you and Morgana. Do not use Leona’s crowd control on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. When low on health, do not stay on Morgana W Tormented Shadow or retreat onto it. If caught by Morgana R Soul Shackles, leave its area before the stun triggers.
Morgana.teamfight: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on an enemy your allies can follow up on and attack. If your team is behind in damage, or Morgana Q Dark Binding roots an allied carry, do not engage first; use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to interrupt enemies who approach your carry. Do not waste crowd control on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.phase: After that, Leona’s damage cannot keep up, so in the mid and late game focus on catching enemies your allies can attack. The available information does not establish which of the two champions is stronger in the mid and late game.
Morgana.build: Build magic resistance first against Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana W Tormented Shadow. Consider tenacity first if the follow-up from her root into the stun from Morgana R Soul Shackles is more dangerous. If Morgana’s crowd control can root and take out an allied carry, buy Mikael’s Blessing earlier; if a prolonged fight lets Morgana heal, consider Grievous Wounds.
Morgana.combo: When Morgana E Black Shield is down on a target, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade to root them, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun them with a basic attack. Follow with Leona W Eclipse. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the target you have already caught, aiming for a center stun, and have your allies attack the same target to trigger Leona P Sunlight.
Morgana.escape: Engage while Morgana Q Dark Binding has missed and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Leona E Zenith Blade and catch her with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you after you engage, use Leona E Zenith Blade to leave its area before the stun triggers.
Morgana.fight: Look to fight after Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Use Leona E Zenith Blade to close in on a target your allied marksman can follow up on and attack, then stun them with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak. Activate Leona W Eclipse right after closing in so it explodes next to the enemy.
Morgana.laning: Keep minions between you and Morgana to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, and look for the moment the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit. Before going in, check your allied marksman’s position and whether they have an attack ability ready. If the engage fails and your abilities are used, pull the lane toward your allied turret.

Ashe.fight: When Ashe steps forward to last-hit and Ashe W Volley is down, check whether your allied marksman can follow up, then engage. Use Leona E Zenith Blade to close the gap in one move instead of walking in and staying exposed to Ashe P Frost Shot. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, create distance and fight after it ends.
Ashe.laning: From a bush or an area without vision, look for an angle to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade when Ashe goes to last-hit. Before engaging, check your allied marksman's position and whether they have an ability ready to attack. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Ashe.phase: After that, Leona's damage won't keep up, so focus on catching Ashe where your allies can attack her. The given information isn't enough to determine which side is stronger in the mid and late game.
Ashe.teamfight: Engage Ashe with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare when she is in a position your allies can reach and attack. Leona P Sunlight can only be triggered by allied attacks, so don't dive somewhere your allies can't reach. If your team is behind in damage, don't engage first; interrupt enemies going onto your allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade.
Ashe.build: Prioritize armor against the main damage from Ashe P Frost Shot, Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, and Ashe W Volley. Armor doesn't block the magic damage from Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. If Ashe's engage can lock down and pick off your allied carry, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Ashe.combo: Engage Ashe with Leona E Zenith Blade and root her. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak, stun her with a basic attack, then activate Leona W Eclipse. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught Ashe to aim for a stun at the center. Leona E Zenith Blade dashes to the last champion hit in a straight line, so check for another enemy behind Ashe before using it.
Ashe.escape: Ashe W Volley being down is an opportunity to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is also down, the risk of being hit by its stun is lower. Ashe has no mobility ability to create distance on her own, so after closing in, chain crowd control with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is an area slow, so sidestep it and look to trade as soon as it's down. Ashe P Frost Shot's slow is refreshed by each basic attack, so don't stay within her basic attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don't start a small fight from out of vision. Change direction as you move to dodge the arrow.

Bard.teamfight: If your team is behind in damage, don't engage first; interrupt enemies going onto your allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade. To start a fight, use Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare on a target your allies can actually follow up on. Leona P Sunlight can only be triggered by allied attacks, so don't dive somewhere your allies can't reach.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a wall or a second target, so avoid standing with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. Watch for Bard E Magical Journey to flank you. Bard R Tempered Fate grants damage immunity, so don't pour attacks into targets caught in its area.
Bard.build: Bard P Traveler's Call and Bard Q Cosmic Binding deal magic damage, so build magic resistance against Bard. If an ally without mobility is likely to be focused after being stunned by Bard Q Cosmic Binding, prioritize tenacity over magic resistance. If Bard's engage can lock down and pick off your allied carry, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Bard.laning: Step on Bard W Caretaker's Shrine visible in lane to remove it as you pass. If an engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Q Shield of Daybreak are both down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Bard.phase: After that, Leona's damage won't keep up, so focus in the mid and late game on catching targets your allies can attack.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and root him. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and stun him with a basic attack. Then activate Leona W Eclipse, and cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center. Leona E Zenith Blade dashes to the last champion hit in a straight line, so check for another enemy behind the target before firing.
Bard.escape: As soon as Bard uses E Magical Journey, close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also down, you can engage while avoiding its stun. Once close, lock Bard down with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and R Solar Flare.
Bard.fight: When your allied marksman can follow up and attack, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade as the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit. If Bard E Magical Journey is down, it's an opportunity to close the gap again and catch Bard. After engaging, activate Leona W Eclipse and fight close enough for its explosion to hit.

Brand.phase: After that, Leona focuses on engaging and crowd control rather than damage, and keeps enough distance to stop Brand's area attacks from spreading to allies. The given information isn't enough to determine which side is stronger in the mid and late game.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out before engaging to keep Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm from spreading between allies. Catch Brand with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare where your allies can follow up and trigger Leona P Sunlight. If your team is behind in damage, instead of engaging first, interrupt enemies going onto your allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade.
Brand.build: Brand's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, making health alone less efficient. Also get movement speed to leave Brand's area attacks.
Brand.combo: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and root him. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and stun him with a basic attack. Then activate Leona W Eclipse so its explosion hits while you are next to Brand. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught Brand to aim for a stun at the center.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is an opportunity to close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade. Brand Q Sear only stuns targets that are ablaze, so if you aren't marked by Blaze, there's less reason to delay your engage out of fear of that stun.
Brand.laning: Stand away from the wave, since Brand E Conflagration can spread from burning minions. If Brand stays within range after using Brand W Pillar of Flame, check your allied damage dealer's position and whether they have an ability ready to attack, then engage. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you are hit by consecutive abilities, then explodes, so it's important to dodge the first Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand Q Sear. If you are ablaze, move out of the Brand Q Sear projectile's path or stand behind a minion to avoid the stun. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from your allies to prevent it from bouncing between you.
Brand.fight: Look to engage when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand isn't marked by Blaze. If your allied damage dealer can follow up, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade and chain crowd control. Once close, use Leona W Eclipse to increase your magic resistance and absorb Brand's attacks.

Hwei.laning: Look for the moment the enemy steps forward to last-hit when your allied marksman can follow up and still has an ability to attack. Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade from a bush or an area without vision, but check that you won't dash onto another champion behind your target in a straight line. If the engage fails, pull the wave toward your allied turret to reduce the chance of a counter-engage.
Hwei.phase: After that, Leona's damage won't keep up, so focus in the mid and late game on catching targets your allies can attack. The given information isn't enough to determine which side is stronger in the mid and late game.
Hwei.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Hwei's damage. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, so consider movement speed to leave its telegraphed area and tenacity against Hwei E Subject: Torment's crowd control instead of investing heavily in health alone.
Hwei.combo: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and root the target. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and stun them with a basic attack. After closing in, activate Leona W Eclipse, then cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center. Use this combo on a target your allies can hit to trigger Leona P Sunlight.
Hwei.escape: Hwei E Subject: Torment being down creates an opportunity to engage. Hwei has no mobility, so close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade then and catch him with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, check whether it has been used before engaging, since it can root or push you away during your engage.
Hwei.fight: Engage just after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear, when your allies can follow up and attack. Close in with Leona E Zenith Blade and chain the stun from Leona Q Shield of Daybreak. Once close, activate Leona W Eclipse to absorb attacks.
Hwei.teamfight: If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and your allies can follow up, catch Hwei with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare. If your team is behind in damage, instead of engaging first, interrupt enemies going onto your allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade. After engaging, absorb enemy attacks while Leona W Eclipse is active, giving your allies time to trigger Leona P Sunlight.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or pulls you, you're likely to be hit by follow-up attacks. If you're hit by Hwei's first ability, including Hwei Q Subject: Disaster, move immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Also watch for follow-up attacks while slowed by Hwei R Spiraling Despair.

Lux.laning: Lux Q Light Binding binds the first two enemies it hits, so don’t stand in line with an ally. Look for an approach from a brush or an area without vision, then engage only after checking that your allied ranged carry can follow up. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Lux.phase: After that, Leona’s damage won’t keep up, so focus on catching targets your allies can attack.
Lux.teamfight: Approach from different directions than your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t stop you all at once. Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on a Lux your allies can follow up and hit, then activate Leona W Eclipse once you’re close. If your team is behind in damage, use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off your allied carry instead of engaging first.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then close in with Leona E Zenith Blade. Follow up with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak’s stun, and fight when your ally’s damage dealer can follow up and attack. Lux has no mobility ability, so she is easy to catch once you close the distance.
Lux.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the spot targeted by Lux E Lucent Singularity. Build magic resistance against Lux’s main damage.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, close in and bind her with Leona E Zenith Blade. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive, then stun her with a basic attack and activate Leona W Eclipse. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught Lux to aim for a stun at the center.
Lux.escape: The moment Lux Q Light Binding is down is your chance to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. Lux has no ability to create distance on her own, so after you close in, interrupt her movement with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, her follow-up abilities are likely to hit too, so bait it out and dodge first. Move out of Lux E Lucent Singularity’s area, and sidestep when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark. If a Lux ability hits you, leave her basic attack range so Lux can’t pop the Illumination mark with a basic attack.

Maokai.watch: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, don’t give him range near a brush. Don’t enter brushes where Maokai E Sapling Toss has planted a sapling, and if a sapling follows you, lure it toward minions or monsters instead of your allies. Maokai R Nature’s Grasp roots for longer at a distance, so dodge perpendicular to its direction of travel.
Maokai.fight: The moment after Maokai uses Maokai W Twisted Advance is your chance to close in with Leona E Zenith Blade. Don’t basic attack while Maokai W Twisted Advance is dashing; stun him with a basic attack empowered by Leona Q Shield of Daybreak after he lands. Engage only when your allied damage dealer can follow up and attack.
Maokai.laning: As the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit, check your allied ranged carry’s position and available attack abilities, then engage. Avoid repeatedly using abilities on Maokai so you don’t frequently trigger healing from Maokai P Sap Magic; target the enemy damage dealer instead. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Maokai.teamfight: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on a target your allies can follow up and attack, letting their attacks pop Leona P Sunlight’s mark. If your team is behind in damage, use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off your allied carry instead of engaging first. Avoid fighting in narrow passages where there is no room to dodge Maokai R Nature’s Grasp.
Maokai.build: Maokai Q Bramble Smash deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid prioritizing large amounts of health alone. Magic resistance is effective against Maokai’s damage, but choose resistance based on the enemy damage dealer who can deal damage while Maokai holds you. Also consider movement speed to get out of Maokai’s area abilities and tenacity to reduce the duration of roots.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, close in and bind him with Leona E Zenith Blade. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and stun him with a basic attack, then activate Leona W Eclipse while you’re close. When casting Leona R Solar Flare, place it over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center.
Maokai.escape: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down. If Maokai R Nature’s Grasp is approaching, first dodge perpendicular to the wall’s direction of travel, and fight in open terrain where there is room to dodge.

Nautilus.fight: The moment after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is a chance to trade and engage. Check that your allied ranged carry can follow up and attack, then close in with Leona E Zenith Blade. If Nautilus uses E Riptide right beside you, move before the wave ends so you don’t get caught by the follow-up explosion.
Nautilus.teamfight: Make sure your allies aren’t clustered along the path of Nautilus R Depth Charge. If your team is behind in damage, don’t engage first; use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off your allied carry. When you engage, target someone your allies can actually follow up and attack so they can pop Leona P Sunlight’s mark.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line is his main engage tool, so stand with minions between you and him to avoid getting hit. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots with his first basic attack, so don’t stay within basic attack range after a trade. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so don’t stand clustered with allies while Nautilus has his ultimate available.
Nautilus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Nautilus Q Dredge Line, W Titan’s Wrath, and E Riptide. If Nautilus’s engage catches and shuts down your allied carry, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, close in and bind him with Leona E Zenith Blade, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as soon as you arrive and stun him with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse as soon as you’re close so Nautilus is beside you when it explodes. Place Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center.
Nautilus.escape: The moment after Nautilus uses Nautilus Q Dredge Line is your chance to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. If you’re hit by Nautilus P Staggering Blow’s root, follow-up abilities can hit too, so don’t linger within basic attack range before engaging.
Nautilus.laning: Dodge Nautilus Q Dredge Line from behind minions, and look for the moment the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit. Before using Leona E Zenith Blade, check your allied ranged carry’s position and available attack abilities. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Nautilus.phase: Here, too, choose an opening when Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down and your allies can attack from their position. After that, Leona should focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up after hitting something, making it easier to root allies standing behind the first target, so do not stand on top of each other. Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup is hidden while she is disguised, so spread out in advance if a suspicious enemy approaches. Ignore Neeko W Shapesplitter’s clone and focus on the real target.
Neeko.laning: Look for an engage angle from a brush or an area without vision, but go in only when your allied marksman can follow. If the engage fails and both Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the lane toward your allied turret.
Neeko.phase: After that, if Leona’s damage can no longer keep up, help your team with engages and crowd control instead of focusing on personal damage.
Neeko.teamfight: Neeko can disguise herself to approach, so spread out from your allies if a suspicious enemy gets close, and leave the area when you see Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup. Leona can save Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to interrupt Neeko’s engage. If your team is behind in damage, protect your carry instead of engaging first; when you do engage, catch a target your allies can follow up on and hit.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first because Neeko’s main damage, including Neeko Q Blooming Burst and Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, is magic damage. Prioritize tenacity if the likely sequence is getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then killed by Neeko R Pop Blossom. If Neeko’s engage can root and take out an allied carry, buy Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade to root her, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun her with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse right after closing in so Neeko is nearby when it explodes. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the Neeko you have already caught, aiming to stun her in the center.
Neeko.escape: If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is also down, close in and stun her with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak, then continue the crowd control with Leona R Solar Flare if it is available.
Neeko.fight: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade as soon as Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down to force a trade. Before going in, make sure your allied marksman can follow up and deal damage. Leona P Sunlight only detonates when an ally attacks, so catch a target your allies can hit.

Rakan.phase: After that, Leona’s damage cannot keep up, so focus on catching targets your allies can attack. The available information does not establish which of the two champions is stronger in the mid and late game.
Rakan.teamfight: If Rakan engages with Rakan W Grand Entrance, stun him with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak or root him with Leona E Zenith Blade right after he lands to stop his movement. Use crowd control before Rakan R The Quickness reaches your allies as well, and avoid standing in a line with them. If your team is behind in damage, interrupt Rakan as he approaches your carry instead of going deep first.
Rakan.escape: The moment after you make Rakan use Rakan W Grand Entrance is an opportunity to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. When Rakan is moving alone, away from his allies, there is no target for him to escape to with Rakan E Battle Dance, so look for a chance to catch him. If Rakan R The Quickness has not reached you yet, interrupt him first with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak.
Rakan.build: Rakan’s main threat is the crowd control he starts with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness, so get a crowd control removal option first. When building resistance, prioritize magic resistance because all of Rakan’s damage is magic damage.
Rakan.combo: After Rakan W Grand Entrance is down, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade to root him, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun him with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse right after closing in, then cast Leona R Solar Flare over the target you have caught, aiming for a center stun. Use this combo on a target your allies can attack so they can trigger Leona P Sunlight.
Rakan.fight: Look to trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is removed. Dodge or bait out Rakan W Grand Entrance, then close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade. Before engaging, check whether your allied marksman can follow up and deal damage.
Rakan.laning: Watch the landing point of Rakan W Grand Entrance and sidestep, then look for an engage when the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit. Before casting Leona E Zenith Blade, check whether another champion is behind your target in its path. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the lane toward your allied turret.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance shows its landing point in advance, so sidestep when Rakan starts moving. Once Rakan R The Quickness is active, escaping on foot is difficult, so stun him with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before he reaches you or put terrain between you. Standing in a line with your allies can let him charm several of you.

Renata.fight: When your allied marksman can follow up and attack, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade as the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit. Renata Glasc has no movement ability of her own, so target Renata Glasc herself if you can get close. After engaging, activate Leona W Eclipse and stay close to hit her with its explosion.
Renata.laning: Look for an engage angle from a brush or an area without vision, but first check your allied marksman’s position and whether they have an attack ability ready. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the lane toward your allied turret.
Renata.phase: After that, Leona’s damage cannot keep up, so in the mid and late game focus on catching targets your allies can attack.
Renata.teamfight: Catch a target your allies can follow up on and attack with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare, and have them trigger Leona P Sunlight with their attacks. When Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, do not engage while grouped in a line with your allies. If your team is behind in damage, do not engage first; interrupt enemies who approach an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first enemy it hits and can throw them into your allies, stunning them too, so dodge it from behind minions or your frontline. Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover makes you attack nearby allies if it hits, so keep your distance from them when her R is available and you engage. Enemies affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout keep fighting briefly after they fall and can revive if they contribute to a takedown, so after catching one, retreat to keep your allies alive.
Renata.escape: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade. Renata Glasc has no movement ability of her own and struggles to escape once you get close, so catch her with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from your allies as you engage.
Renata.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from Renata Glasc P Leverage, Renata Glasc Q Handshake, and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Renata Glasc P Leverage deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid options that only add a large amount of health. If Renata Glasc’s crowd control can lock down and take out an allied carry, buy Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Renata.combo: Close in on Renata Glasc with Leona E Zenith Blade to root her, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun her with a basic attack. Follow with Leona W Eclipse, then cast Leona R Solar Flare over the target you have caught, aiming for a center stun. Leona E Zenith Blade dashes to the last champion it hits in a straight line, so check for another enemy behind her before casting.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through the target in a straight line, so avoid the line connecting Senna to an ally or a minion in front of her. Senna W Last Embrace takes time to root after it hits, so move away from your allies as soon as you are marked. If Senna hits you once, retreat so she cannot land a second attack and collect mist.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul or last-hit, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade if your allied damage dealer can follow up. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, so after closing in, stun her with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and keep her in place for your allies to attack. Before using Leona E Zenith Blade, check whether another enemy is behind your target in its path.
Senna.build: Build armor first because Senna’s main damage is physical. Senna P Absolution adds damage based on your current health to her basic attacks, so build armor along with health instead of stacking only health. After engaging and closing in, use Leona W Eclipse to increase your armor.
Senna.combo: Close in on Senna with Leona E Zenith Blade to root her, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun her with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse right after closing in so Senna is within range when it explodes. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the Senna you have already caught, aiming for a center stun.
Senna.escape: The moment after Senna W Last Embrace is blocked by a minion or misses is an opportunity to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. Judge the distance while Senna E Curse of the Black Mist increases her movement speed, and retreat if enemy allies approach through the mist. When you engage, continue to catch Senna with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak or Leona R Solar Flare.
Senna.laning: Pressure Senna from the early game by watching where she steps out to collect souls, preventing her from collecting mist. Senna W Last Embrace is blocked by minions, so avoid its angle from behind minions. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the lane toward your allied turret.
Senna.phase: In the early game, pressure Senna aggressively because her health is low and Leona’s armor is high. After that, Leona should focus on crowd control and roaming, and prevent Senna from collecting souls to increase her range and attack damage.
Senna.teamfight: When Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, enemy allies can also approach while camouflaged, so retreat to an area with vision or cast Leona R Solar Flare into the mist. When engaging, catch a target your allies can actually follow up on and attack so they can trigger Leona P Sunlight. If your team is behind in damage, interrupt enemies who approach an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade instead of engaging first.

Sona.phase: Sona gets stronger as the game goes on, and Leona's damage will not keep up, so focus on engaging and crowd control starting in the mid game. In the late game, Sona's healing aura makes extended teamfights unfavorable, so quickly catch a target your allies can hit.
Sona.teamfight: When Sona steps forward to use Sona R Crescendo, spread out to either side of your allies and disrupt her positioning with Leona E Zenith Blade or Leona R Solar Flare. Separating Sona from her team can keep her healing, shielding, and movement speed auras from reaching them. If your team is behind in damage, do not go deep first; peel enemies off an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns every ally hit in a straight line, so do not line up with your allies when Sona steps forward. After Sona has used her basic abilities several times, watch out for empowered Sona P Power Chord and create distance when she comes within basic attack range.
Sona.laning: Sona is weak early and her abilities cost a lot of mana, so get on top of her and force trades. Create an engage angle from a brush or an area without vision, but check for another enemy behind your target in a straight line before using Leona E Zenith Blade. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Sona.build: Build magic resistance first against Sona's main damage. Sona W Aria of Perseverance provides repeated healing, so make sure your team has at least one Grievous Wounds item. If Sona R Crescendo can catch and take out an allied carry, get Mikael's Blessing early.
Sona.combo: Use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of and root Sona, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun her with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse right after getting on top of her. Place Leona R Solar Flare over Sona once she is already caught to aim for a stun at the center.
Sona.escape: After Sona E Song of Celerity's movement speed boost is down, close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade. Engaging while Sona R Crescendo is down also lowers the risk of being stopped by its stun. If Sona E Song of Celerity is still available, do not rely on a slow alone; chain immobilizing effects with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak.
Sona.fight: Trade when Sona steps forward to activate an aura or when the enemy ranged carry comes up to last-hit. After checking that your allied ranged carry can follow up and attack, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of them and chain immobilizing effects. Focus on a target your allies can hit to trigger Leona P Sunlight.

Soraka.teamfight: If you can catch Soraka where your allies can follow up and hit her, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare to stop her healing. Before going deep, check whether another champion is in Leona E Zenith Blade's line. If your team is behind in damage, do not go in first; peel enemies off an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade.
Soraka.fight: When Soraka E Equinox is down, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of her and follow with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak's stun. Before engaging, check that your allied ranged carry can follow up and attack. Concentrate your damage in a short time so Soraka has no time to heal.
Soraka.laning: Look for an engage when the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit. Pressure your allied ranged carry to make Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall so she cannot heal herself. If the engage fails and both Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Soraka.phase: Leona's damage will not keep up after that, so in the mid and late game catch targets your allies can attack and help them focus their damage against Soraka's healing.
Soraka.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Soraka Q Starcall and Soraka E Equinox. Use Leona W Eclipse's magic resistance increase while you are on top of Soraka as well. If the fight drags on and Soraka keeps healing, consider Grievous Wounds next.
Soraka.combo: After Soraka E Equinox is down, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of and root her, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun her with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse right after getting on top of her so Soraka is beside you when it explodes. If Leona R Solar Flare is available, place it over Soraka once she is already caught to aim for a stun at the center.
Soraka.escape: The chance to go in is right after Soraka E Equinox is used to poke or clear the wave. Soraka has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade and catch her with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak. If Soraka E Equinox's zone is already down, use your engage ability before entering it.
Soraka.watch: Entering Soraka E Equinox's zone silences you, so use Leona E Zenith Blade before stepping into the zone. Soraka Q Starcall slows Leona and heals Soraka, so dodge it. Soraka R Wish heals her allies, so you need to deal your damage in a short time.

Thresh.laning: Create an angle from a brush or an area without vision, but do not go in if your allies cannot follow. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Thresh.teamfight: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on a target your allies can follow up and hit. If your team is behind in damage, do not go in first; peel enemies off an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade. When Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, either finish off its target immediately or back away. If you are trapped by Thresh R The Box, choose the wall for your toughest ally to break so you can escape.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence can catch an ally and lead into a dash, so move to the side when you see him raise his hook. When stepping forward to last-hit, change direction once more, and avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay does not pull you toward them.
Thresh.build: If Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay can catch your allied ranged carry, get Mikael's Blessing early. When building resistance against Thresh's ability damage, choose magic resistance.
Thresh.combo: When Thresh has used his means of escape and there is a target your allies can attack, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of and root them. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun them with a basic attack, then activate Leona W Eclipse. Place Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center.
Thresh.escape: Do not go in as soon as you dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence; also check whether Thresh W Dark Passage is still down. Use that opening to close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade and catch him with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare.
Thresh.fight: Close the gap right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence to the side, and engage with Leona E Zenith Blade while Thresh W Dark Passage is down too. You also have a chance to trade when Thresh steps forward to collect souls, but first check that your allied ranged carry can follow up and hit him.
Thresh.phase: As time passes, Thresh gains armor from collecting souls, while Leona's damage will not keep up, so Leona should focus on engaging and crowd control. Leona deals mostly magic damage, and Thresh tends to have low magic resistance, so you can deal damage to him.

Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the chance to go in is right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of him and keep him caught with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak. If the engage fails, Leona E Zenith Blade cannot be used to escape, so pull the wave toward your allied turret after your abilities are down.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Xerath has no mobility, so you can fight favorably once you get on top of him, but first check that your allies can follow up and attack from there. Leona's magic damage is effective against Xerath, who tends to have low magic resistance.
Xerath.teamfight: Catch Xerath where your allies can follow up and attack to apply Leona P Sunlight. If your team is behind in damage, do not go deep first; peel enemies off an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade. If you engage, absorb enemy attacks while Leona W Eclipse is active and create time for your allies to attack.
Xerath.build: Get a way to block or remove Xerath E Shocking Orb's stun first. If that stun can catch and take out an allied carry, get Mikael's Blessing early. Xerath's attacks deal magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor, and get movement speed to escape telegraphed attacks.
Xerath.combo: When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of and root him. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun him with a basic attack, then activate Leona W Eclipse. Place Leona R Solar Flare over Xerath once he is already caught to aim for a stun at the center.
Xerath.laning: Rather than trying to dodge all of Xerath's poke, endure it while avoiding the heavy damage. After Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the wave and call your jungler. Create an engage angle from a brush where Xerath has trouble seeing Leona, and if the lane is stalled, get vision in the river and look to join your team in mid lane.
Xerath.phase: After that, Leona's damage will not keep up, so focus on engaging and crowd control. Stay alert to Xerath's long range, but the available information is not enough to say which side is stronger in the mid and late game.
Xerath.watch: Avoid Xerath E Shocking Orb first, since its stun can leave you open to all the attacks that follow. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and move well to the side. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or engage on Xerath while he cannot move.

Zyra.laning: Step on seeds along your route to destroy them, but if Zyra starts casting an ability, back away and then step on them again. When the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit, check your allies’ positions and abilities before engaging. After Leona E Zenith Blade and Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Zyra.fight: Engage when Zyra E Grasping Roots misses and there are no plants nearby. Check that your allied ranged carry can follow up, then use Leona E Zenith Blade to close in and chain crowd control.
Zyra.build: Build movement speed first so you can leave telegraphed attack areas. When building resistance, choose magic resistance against Zyra’s magic damage.
Zyra.combo: When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, use Leona E Zenith Blade to close in and root the target. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and stun them with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse as soon as you’re on them, and cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so right after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to engage. If you’re caught in Zyra R Stranglethorns, look for a route out using Leona E Zenith Blade.
Zyra.phase: In mid game, avoid fights in areas covered with plants, secure vision, and look for chances to join your team. In late game, Leona’s crowd control and positioning that lets allies follow up matter more than her damage.
Zyra.teamfight: Moving the fight away from an area where Zyra has been set up for a long time can make her stored seeds useless. Engage a target your allies can follow up on with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare. If your team is behind in damage, use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off an allied carry.
Zyra.watch: Zyra E Grasping Roots travels in a straight line and roots you, so dodge sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the summon indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, leave the area to avoid being knocked up, and don’t fight where her plants are clustered.

Milio.build: Don’t build armor first just because of Milio’s damage. Choose resistance based on the enemy damage dealers’ damage types, and build magic resistance if you need to absorb Milio’s magic damage. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life becomes a problem, get a source of Grievous Wounds.
Milio.fight: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and your allied ranged carry can follow up. Once close, stun him with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and use Leona W Eclipse to absorb damage beside the enemy. Milio has no mobility ability and low defensive stats, so you can target him first if your allies are in position to attack with you.
Milio.laning: As the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit, check your allied ranged carry’s position and available attack abilities, then engage. Look for an angle for Leona E Zenith Blade from a brush or an area without vision, but if you miss the ability, pull the wave toward your allied turret. If the lane is stalled, establish vision in the river and look to join a fight in mid.
Milio.teamfight: If you can catch Milio in a position where your allies can follow up and attack, target him first to cut off the enemy team’s healing support. If your team is behind in damage, don’t engage first; use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off your allied carry. After engaging, absorb damage beside the enemy while Leona W Eclipse is active, and let your allies attack targets marked by Leona P Sunlight.
Milio.combo: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade and bind him. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive, stun him with a basic attack, then use Leona W Eclipse. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only way to push you away, so its cooldown is your chance to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. Before engaging, check the straight-line path of Leona E Zenith Blade so you don’t dash to another champion standing behind him.
Milio.phase: Milio’s team gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the early game, wear him down through trades to drain his mana and gain control of the wave. After that, Leona should focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick can push Leona away even after Leona E Zenith Blade closes in, so check whether Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down before engaging. Delay fighting the frontline while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy ranged carry’s range. Keep Milio R Breath of Life in mind in teamfights, as it grants healing and tenacity.

Nami.fight: Target Nami right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, when your allied ranged carry can follow up. Nami has no mobility ability and low health, so close in with Leona E Zenith Blade and chain into Leona Q Shield of Daybreak’s stun. Activate Leona W Eclipse as soon as you’re close so Nami is beside you when it explodes.
Nami.laning: Look for an angle to engage Nami with Leona E Zenith Blade from a brush or an area without vision. You can also engage as the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit, but first check your allied ranged carry’s position and available attack abilities. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Nami.phase: After that, Leona’s damage won’t keep up, so use crowd control to help your allies attack. If the lane is stalled, establish vision in the river and look to join a fight in mid. The information provided isn’t enough to judge which side is stronger in the late game.
Nami.teamfight: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on a target your allies can follow up and attack. If your team is behind in damage, don’t engage first; use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off your allied carry. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep and watch for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison falls slowly, but stuns if it hits, so sidestep when you see it coming. Nami R Tidal Wave travels from a distance and knocks you up, making the follow-up combo dangerous, so sidestep as soon as you see it and save Leona E Zenith Blade so you can dodge the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow. Don’t fight head-on with an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing; wait for its duration to end.
Nami.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Nami’s ability damage. Get movement speed to leave the targeted areas of Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave, and consider tenacity if the crowd control is a problem. If Nami’s engage catches and shuts down your allied carry, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Nami.combo: After Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, close in and bind her with Leona E Zenith Blade. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun her with a basic attack, then activate Leona W Eclipse. If you cast Leona R Solar Flare, place it over the caught Nami to aim for a stun at the center.
Nami.escape: The best window to engage Nami is right after Nami Q Aqua Prison, which has a long cooldown, misses. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep first, watch for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow, then close the distance with Leona E Zenith Blade. Resume fighting an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing after its duration ends.

Pyke.laning: Use a brush or an area without vision to create an angle for Leona E Zenith Blade, but check your allied marksman’s position and whether they have an attack ability ready first. Keep Pyke visible with wards as he retreats after a trade to prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the lane toward your allied turret.
Pyke.phase: After that, Leona should focus on engages and crowd control over damage. The provided information does not establish which side is stronger in the mid and late game; in the late game, keep low-health allies behind the frontline and move with them.
Pyke.teamfight: If your team is behind in damage, interrupt Pyke as he approaches your carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade instead of engaging first. Do not stand beside low-health allies, so you do not get hit together by the X-shaped area of Pyke R Death From Below or get caught in a chain of executions. If you have an opportunity to engage first, use Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on a target your allies can actually hit, and have them trigger Leona P Sunlight with their attacks.
Pyke.watch: Be careful not to get hit by Pyke Q Bone Skewer before engaging, as it can pull or knock you back and slow you. Pyke E Phantom Undertow leaves a stun along the path of his dash, so move to the side of the direction he traveled. If you see a shark shadow beneath you, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is approaching, so retreat toward your allies or inside your turret’s range.
Pyke.build: Secure health first and then build armor against Pyke’s damage. Pyke builds physical penetration early and uses Pyke R Death From Below to execute low-health targets, so having enough health to stay above the execute threshold matters more than a small amount of armor. Do not build magic resistance to block Pyke’s ability damage.
Pyke.combo: When Pyke’s escape option is down, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade to root him, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun him with a basic attack. Follow with Leona W Eclipse, then cast Leona R Solar Flare over the target you have caught, aiming for a center stun. Leona E Zenith Blade dashes to the last champion hit in a straight line, so check for another enemy behind your target before casting.
Pyke.escape: The moment after dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow is an opportunity to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. Pyke can also move with Pyke R Death From Below, so do not automatically engage just because Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down. In particular, if Pyke R Death From Below is not back up yet, catch him with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare.
Pyke.fight: Look for the moment the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit when your allied marksman can follow up and attack. If you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, counterattack by closing the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade. Activate Leona W Eclipse immediately after engaging to benefit from its armor and magic resistance while you stay close.

Seraphine.fight: Look to trade when Seraphine is alone, away from your allied marksman. If you close in with Leona E Zenith Blade right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, it is easier to catch Seraphine, who has no movement ability. Before engaging, check whether your allied marksman can follow up and attack.
Seraphine.laning: Look to engage when the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit. Use a brush or an area without vision to create an angle for Leona E Zenith Blade, but first check whether another enemy is standing in its path. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the lane toward your allied turret.
Seraphine.phase: In the mid and late game, Leona’s damage cannot keep up, so focus on catching targets your allies can attack.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to the sides so Seraphine R Encore cannot follow your allies and reach those behind them. Engage on a target your allies can follow up on and attack with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare. If your team is behind in damage, interrupt enemies who approach an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade instead of engaging first.
Seraphine.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Seraphine P Stage Presence, Seraphine Q High Note, and Seraphine E Beat Drop. If Seraphine’s crowd control can lock down and take out an allied carry, buy Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade to root her. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun her with a basic attack, then use Leona W Eclipse. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the Seraphine you have already caught, aiming for a center stun.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is an opportunity to engage. Seraphine has no movement ability, so close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade and catch her with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you are slowed, first get out of the path of Seraphine E Beat Drop. In teamfights, spread out to the sides from your allies because Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an ally.

Swain.escape: Swain has no mobility ability to create distance, so the chance to go in with Leona E Zenith Blade is right after Swain E Nevermove is down. Before engaging, check for another enemy behind your target in Leona E Zenith Blade's straight line so you are not pulled deeper into the enemy team. If the engage fails and both Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Swain.fight: Use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of Swain right after Swain E Nevermove is down, when your allied ranged carry can follow up and attack. Catch him briefly to let your ally hit him, and do not prolong the fight beside Swain while Swain R Demonic Ascension is active.
Swain.laning: The health Swain stacks is permanent, so look for chances to pressure him early. Look for an engage when the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit, but first check your allied ranged carry's position and which abilities they can use to attack. Create an unseen engage angle from a brush, and if the lane is stalled, get vision in the river and look to join fights mid.
Swain.build: Swain Q Death's Hand, W Vision of Empire, and E Nevermove all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Also activate Leona W Eclipse right after getting on top of Swain to increase your magic resistance, and stay beside him so the explosion hits. If you are fighting Swain's healing from Swain P Ravenous Flock and R Demonic Ascension in the late game, get Grievous Wounds before going in.
Swain.combo: When Swain E Nevermove is down, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of and root him. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun him with a basic attack, then activate Leona W Eclipse. If you use Leona R Solar Flare, place it over Swain after he is already caught to aim for a stun at the center.
Swain.phase: Swain gets tougher as the game goes on, so do not assume the same engage angle will catch him in the late game.
Swain.teamfight: When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, he drains nearby enemies to heal, so leave its range and reengage after it ends. Use Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak to catch Swain where your allies can follow up and hit him, letting them trigger Leona P Sunlight. If your team is behind in damage, peel enemies off an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade instead of going deep first.
Swain.watch: Even if you dodge the first wave of Swain E Nevermove, you can still be rooted and pulled by the wave as it returns. Stay out of its path until it fully disappears. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with several bolts at close range, so keep your distance unless you are going in.

Lulu.escape: The chance to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade comes right after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally. Lulu has no dash to get herself out, so close the distance and catch her with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare.
Lulu.build: Choose your first defensive purchase based on the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting. If you’re considering only Lulu’s damage, magic resistance is more useful than armor. Consider tenacity against the crowd control from Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Lulu.combo: After Lulu W Whimsy is down, close in and bind her with Leona E Zenith Blade. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun her with a basic attack, then activate Leona W Eclipse while you’re close. If you cast Leona R Solar Flare, place it over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center.
Lulu.fight: Lulu is good at stopping major engages, so first harass steadily with your allies and look for a chance to bait out Lulu W Whimsy. When engaging, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade on a target your allied damage dealer can follow up and attack, then chain your immobilizing effects with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. When the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit, check your allied damage dealer’s position and available ways to attack before engaging. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Lulu.phase: After that, Leona’s damage won’t keep up, so focus on engaging and crowd control. The information available isn’t enough to determine whether Lulu or Leona is stronger in the mid to late game.
Lulu.teamfight: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on a target your allies can actually follow up and attack, applying Leona P Sunlight’s mark. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, target Lulu herself or someone else instead of the target she can protect. If your team is behind in damage, use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off your allied carry instead of engaging first.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences Leona and stops her engage, so don’t engage first with Leona E Zenith Blade while it’s available. Lulu R Wild Growth can save a target and knock up nearby enemies, so if R is still available, don’t commit deep expecting a kill on that target. Watch out for the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance as well.

Blitzcrank.laning: Don't stand beside the minions; keep minions in front of you to block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Get vision in bushes and watch Blitzcrank's mana. Push the wave or trade when his grab misses or he lacks mana. If an engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Blitzcrank.phase: After that, Leona's damage won't keep up, so focus on catching targets your allies can attack.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Start a fight with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare on an enemy your allies can follow up on, and don't miss a target farther back while focusing only on Blitzcrank. If your team is behind in damage, don't engage first; interrupt enemies going onto your allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade. After engaging, activate Leona W Eclipse and absorb the enemy's abilities.
Blitzcrank.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and R Static Field. Magic resistance doesn't block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist, and Blitzcrank R Static Field destroys shields, so don't rely on shields to survive.
Blitzcrank.combo: When Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down and your allies can follow up, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and root the target. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and stun them with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse as soon as you close in, and cast Leona R Solar Flare over the center of a target already caught. Apply Leona P Sunlight to a target your allies can attack.
Blitzcrank.escape: Just after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is an opportunity to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so after catching him, chain the time he can't move with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and R Solar Flare.
Blitzcrank.fight: Look to trade and engage just after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit. First check whether your allied marksman can follow up and attack. Before using Leona E Zenith Blade, check for enemies behind your target along its line to avoid an engage that leaves you isolated.
Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls in the first target it hits, so keep minions in front of you and stay well away from bushes without vision. After being pulled, you can be hit by Blitzcrank E Power Fist's knock-up and then silenced by Blitzcrank R Static Field, so don't recklessly step forward while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is available.

Braum.phase: After that, Leona's damage won't keep up, so focus in the mid and late game on catching targets your allies can attack.
Braum.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Braum's direct damage. If Braum's engage can lock down and pick off your allied carry, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Braum.combo: Just after Braum uses W Stand Behind Me, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and root the target. Activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak on arrival and stun them with a basic attack, then use Leona W Eclipse. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center.
Braum.escape: Just after Braum uses W Stand Behind Me is an opportunity to close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade. If Braum Q Winter's Bite and R Glacial Fissure are also down, engage during that window and lock him down with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and R Solar Flare.
Braum.fight: When your allied marksman can follow up and attack, engage as the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit. If Braum E Unbreakable is blocking damage from the front, wait until his shield drops or you have an angle from the side. Instead of pouring attacks into Braum, catch a target your allies can attack to trigger Leona P Sunlight.
Braum.laning: Stand behind minions to dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite, and avoid gaps between minions that put you in a straight line with Braum. If an engage fails and both abilities are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret to reduce the chance of a counter-engage.
Braum.teamfight: Engage with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare on a target your allies can follow up on. If your team is behind in damage, instead of engaging first, interrupt enemies going onto your allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade. While Braum E Unbreakable is blocking damage from the front, help your allies find an angle to attack from the side, and dodge the line of Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Braum.watch: Braum Q Winter's Bite slows the first enemy hit and can start the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows, so dodge it from behind minions. If you are marked, move out of range before stacks build up. Projectiles are blocked in the direction Braum E Unbreakable faces, so wait until his shield drops or an angle from the side opens. Watch the cast animation of Braum R Glacial Fissure and dodge out of its line, and don't step into the slow zone it leaves behind.

Janna.phase: After that, Leona’s damage won’t keep up, so focus on catching targets your allies can attack. The information available isn’t enough to determine whether either champion is stronger in the mid or late game.
Janna.build: The information available isn’t enough to determine an item to buy first. If you build resistance against Janna’s damage, magic resistance is more useful than armor, but Janna deals little damage, so there’s rarely a reason to build resistance early just for her.
Janna.combo: Close in with Leona E Zenith Blade and bind the target, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun them with a basic attack. Follow up with Leona W Eclipse so it explodes beside the target. When casting Leona R Solar Flare, place it over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center.
Janna.escape: The chance to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade comes after Janna Q Howling Gale misses and Janna R Monsoon is down. If Janna Q Howling Gale is charging outside vision, don’t engage until you’ve checked its path. If Janna E Eye Of The Storm is also down, you have less reason to worry about damage being absorbed by a shield.
Janna.fight: When your allied ranged carry can follow up and attack, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade as the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit. If Janna E Eye Of The Storm is already on a target, wait for the shield to expire or target someone else instead of focusing damage on them. If Janna is isolated, close in with Leona E Zenith Blade and chain your immobilizing effects.
Janna.laning: Harass the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, and bait out Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Janna.teamfight: If Janna is stopping engages from behind allied damage dealers, establish vision and look for a moment when she is isolated. When engaging from the front, use Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on a target your allies can follow up and attack, and decide whether to save a way to interrupt Janna R Monsoon. If your team is behind in damage, use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off your allied carry instead of engaging first.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks you up and interrupts your engage, so avoid its path if you hear it charging from a brush or outside vision. Janna R Monsoon can push away a Leona who has closed in and undo the fight, so decide whether to save Leona Q Shield of Daybreak to interrupt it when she casts. Don’t unload all your damage at once on a target affected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm.

Rell.laning: Look for an engage when the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit. Create an angle for Leona E Zenith Blade from a brush or an area without vision, but check that no other enemy is behind your target in a straight line, so you do not dash to the wrong target. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Rell.teamfight: Before going in, spread out from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm does not pull several of you in together. Use Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona R Solar Flare on a target your allies can follow up and hit. After you get on top of them, absorb enemy abilities while Leona W Eclipse is active. If your team is behind in damage, or Rell is going for an allied carry, peel with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade instead of engaging first.
Rell.watch: When Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and an ally together, it signals an imminent engage, so stop trading and move out of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. Rell Q Shattering Strike comes in a straight line, so dodge to the side. Keep space from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm does not pull several of you in together.
Rell.build: If Rell is looking to catch and take out an allied carry, get Mikael's Blessing early. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Rell's main damage, though its value drops while Rell P Break the Mold is reducing your resistances. Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Rell.combo: Use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of and root the target, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun them with a basic attack. Follow with Leona W Eclipse so it explodes beside the enemy. Place Leona R Solar Flare over a target you have already caught to aim for a stun at the center.
Rell.escape: Do not go in just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down. The chance to close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade is after Rell E Full Tilt is down and before it comes back up; then catch Rell with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare.
Rell.fight: Wait outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range, then engage while Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and Rell E Full Tilt are down. Before using Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of Rell, check that your allied ranged carry can follow up and attack. Leona deals mostly magic damage, and Rell tends to have low magic resistance, so attack the Rell you catch together with your allies.
Rell.phase: Leona's damage will not keep up after that, so focus on engaging and crowd control in the mid and late game. The available information is not enough to say which side is stronger.

Heimerdinger.fight: Don't repeatedly trade damage in front of Heimerdinger's turrets. Approach Heimerdinger himself from the side or a bush. Before going in, check whether your allied damage dealer can follow up and trigger Leona P Sunlight.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: Approach Heimerdinger from the side where your allies can follow up, then catch him with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare so your allies can trigger Leona P Sunlight. After engaging, use Leona W Eclipse while you are close to the enemy to absorb attacks. If your team is behind in damage, don't dive in first; interrupt enemies going onto your allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade.
Heimerdinger.build: Heimerdinger's turret, rocket, and grenade damage is all magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Leona W Eclipse can also increase your magic resistance. Get movement speed to leave the areas Heimerdinger telegraphs.
Heimerdinger.combo: Engage Heimerdinger with Leona E Zenith Blade and root him. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and stun him with a basic attack. Then activate Leona W Eclipse so its explosion hits while you are close. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught Heimerdinger to aim for a stun at the center.
Heimerdinger.escape: It's a better time to engage just after Heimerdinger uses all his turret placement charges or a turret finishes firing a powerful shot. Before firing E, check that another champion isn't behind your target in a straight line, which could make you dash deeper.
Heimerdinger.phase: Afterward, Leona focuses on engaging and crowd control rather than damage, and goes around Heimerdinger's turret setup to catch a target your allies can attack.

Karma.laning: Reposition to avoid free hits from Karma Q Inner Flame that would reduce Karma R Mantra’s cooldown. When your allied ranged carry can follow up, engage with Leona E Zenith Blade as the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Karma.phase: After that, Leona’s damage won’t keep up, so in the mid and late game, focus on catching targets your allies can attack. The information available isn’t enough to determine which of the two champions is stronger in the mid or late game.
Karma.build: Karma’s main damage is magic, so buy a magic resistance item first. Get movement speed to help you leave the range of Karma Q Inner Flame and break the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve.
Karma.combo: Close in and bind the target with Leona E Zenith Blade, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun them with a basic attack. Activate Leona W Eclipse as soon as you’re close, and place the center of Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to extend the stun. Choose a target your allies can attack so they can pop Leona P Sunlight’s mark.
Karma.escape: The chance to engage with Leona E Zenith Blade comes after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. If Karma E Inspire creates distance or the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active, engage after its effect expires. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you first, create distance before you’re rooted.
Karma.fight: Engage when Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire’s shield has expired. Use Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak together to chain immobilizing effects, then activate Leona W Eclipse as soon as you’re close to absorb damage.
Karma.teamfight: If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, Leona may be caught on her own if she engages first, so bait it out before engaging. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is on nearby allies, engage after it expires. If your team is behind in damage, use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off your allied carry.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals area damage, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid being hit. If you’re hit by the area from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, move outside the circle before it explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, create distance to break it before you’re rooted.

Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of him when your allied ranged carry can follow up. Vel'Koz has no mobility, so chain Leona Q Shield of Daybreak's stun after Leona E Zenith Blade's root, and fight where your allies can attack.
Velkoz.laning: Engage when the enemy steps forward to last-hit, after checking your allied ranged carry's position and which abilities they can use to attack. Create an approach angle from a brush or an area without vision, and clear vision in the river and tri-brush to limit safe spots where Vel'Koz can poke. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Velkoz.phase: Leona's damage will not keep up after that, so in the mid and late game focus on catching enemies your allies can hit.
Velkoz.build: Get movement speed first so you can escape telegraphed areas. Build magic resistance against Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, W Void Rift, and E Tectonic Disruption, and build health against the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Velkoz.combo: When Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of and root him, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun him with a basic attack before activating Leona W Eclipse. Place Leona R Solar Flare over the caught Vel'Koz to aim for a stun at the center. Leona E Zenith Blade dashes to the last champion it hits in a straight line, so check for another enemy behind Vel'Koz before firing.
Velkoz.escape: The chance to go in is right after Vel'Koz's reliable crowd control, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, misses. Vel'Koz has no mobility, so close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade and keep him caught with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak. If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is still available, he can knock you back at close range right after you engage, so have a way to finish the fight ready.
Velkoz.teamfight: Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray channels in place, so interrupt it first with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak or Leona R Solar Flare's center stun when it starts. If your allies can follow up and attack from your position, open up the fight with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare. If your team is behind in damage, peel enemies off an allied carry with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade. After engaging, activate Leona W Eclipse and stay beside enemies to land the explosion and absorb their attacks.
Velkoz.watch: With Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, you also need to dodge the split beam, so do not only move sideways; move toward Vel'Koz or behind the beam after it passes. If Vel'Koz W Void Rift and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption hit in succession, Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers true damage, so back away and let it wear off when you have stacks.
