When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt it first with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak's stun or Leona R Solar Flare's center stun.

Zilean.fight: Zilean has no mobility spell, so when you get a chance to close the gap, use Leona E Zenith Blade to stick to him and apply pressure. Engage when your allied damage dealers can follow up, and make sure they attack targets marked with Leona P Sunlight.
Zilean.teamfight: Engage a target your allies can follow up on with Leona E Zenith Blade and R Solar Flare. If your team is behind in damage, use Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and E Zenith Blade to peel enemies off an allied carry. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on an enemy damage dealer and makes them hard to finish, switch to the more vulnerable Zilean. Don’t waste abilities while the target revives with Zilean R Chronoshift; be ready to engage again as soon as they revive.
Zilean.build: Build tenacity early in case Zilean Q Time Bomb and E Time Warp leave you caught and taking enemy attacks, and build magic resistance against Zilean’s magic damage. If Zilean’s engage catches and shuts down an allied carry, prioritize Mikael’s Blessing.
Zilean.combo: Use Leona E Zenith Blade to close in and root the target. On arrival, activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and stun them with a basic attack, then use Leona W Eclipse. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the caught target to aim for a stun at the center. Before firing Leona E Zenith Blade, check that you won’t dash to another enemy behind your target in a straight line.
Zilean.escape: When Zilean E Time Warp is down, it’s harder for him to stop your engage with a slow if you close the gap with Leona E Zenith Blade.
Zilean.laning: When the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit, check your allied damage dealer’s position and which abilities they can use to attack before engaging.
Zilean.phase: From then on, Leona should focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.
Zilean.watch: When Zilean Q Time Bomb sticks two bombs to the same target, they stun. As soon as the first bomb attaches, move away from your allies and out of the blast radius. If you engage alone after taking the slow from Zilean E Time Warp, you can easily get caught in his bomb combo.

Taric.fight: Dodge Taric E Dazzle to the side and trade after its stun is down, when your allied ranged carry can follow up. Taric cannot create distance on his own, so use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of him and chain into Leona Q Shield of Daybreak's stun. Do not stay in a melee fight taking empowered basic attacks from Taric P Bravado for long.
Taric.phase: Both champions are tough early, and Taric P Bravado's melee damage is also strong, so do not stay in a fight for long. Leona's damage will not keep up after that, so focus on crowd control and protecting your allies.
Taric.build: Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If Taric's stun engage can catch and take out an allied carry, get Mikael's Blessing early.
Taric.combo: During the window when Taric E Dazzle is down, use Leona E Zenith Blade to get on top of and root him, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun him with a basic attack before using Leona W Eclipse. Place Leona R Solar Flare over the target once they are already caught to aim for a stun at the center. Leona E Zenith Blade dashes to the last champion hit in its line, so check for enemies behind your target before using it.
Taric.escape: The chance to go in with Leona E Zenith Blade is right after Taric E Dazzle is down. Taric has no skill to create distance on his own, so after catching him you can keep stopping his movement with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare.
Taric.laning: When the enemy ranged carry steps forward to last-hit, check your allied ranged carry's position and means of attack, then engage. If the engage fails and Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are down, pull the wave toward your allied turret.
Taric.teamfight: When you see the cast animation for Taric R Cosmic Radiance, decide whether to disengage your allies or pick off an enemy damage dealer before damage immunity activates. While immunity is active, catch enemies with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak, Leona E Zenith Blade, and Leona R Solar Flare, so your allies can attack again as soon as it ends. If your team is behind in damage, peel enemies off a carry instead of going deep first, and when engaging, choose a target your allies can follow up and hit.
Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle is a delayed stun, so dodge to the side when you see its tell. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity activates, do not unload your attacks; keep enemies caught with crowd control until it ends.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first because Pantheon’s main damage is physical. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid options that only add a large amount of health. If Pantheon is likely to jump on and stun an allied carry, buy Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Pantheon.combo: Close in with Leona E Zenith Blade to root the target, then activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak as you arrive and stun them with a basic attack. Follow with Leona W Eclipse so its explosion hits while you stay close. Cast Leona R Solar Flare over the target you have caught, aiming to stun them in the center.
Pantheon.escape: Your window to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. Use Leona E Zenith Blade to close the gap, then catch him with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare. If only one of Pantheon’s movement options is down, he can escape with the other, so do not chase recklessly.
Pantheon.fight: Engage once both Leona E Zenith Blade and Leona Q Shield of Daybreak are ready, and your allied marksman can follow up and attack. When Pantheon uses Pantheon E Aegis Assault, wait until it ends or approach from the side instead of dealing damage from the front.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions in areas where Pantheon Q Comet Spear can hit you with poke. Pantheon W Shield Vault can lock down an allied carry, so keep more distance when Pantheon is paired with an enemy who also has crowd control. Look to engage when the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit, after checking your allies’ positions and whether they have attacks ready.
Pantheon.phase: After that, Leona should focus on engages and crowd control, and keep buying time against Pantheon, whose impact declines later in the game.
Pantheon.teamfight: If Pantheon jumps on an allied carry with Pantheon W Shield Vault, interrupt him with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona E Zenith Blade. If your team is behind in damage, protect your carry instead of engaging first. When you engage, catch a target your allies can actually follow up on and attack, so they can trigger Leona P Sunlight.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so be careful not to enter its range. When Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke, keep minions between you and him. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.
